sticky-fixed-content-consumes-small-view.mechanism: Fixed author content obscures the element with keyboard focus at the reflow viewport: aside.ad is position:fixed (left:10px;right:10px;bottom:8px;height:180px) spanning the lower band, so when the in-article 'listening guide' link (a.inline href=#listen) is focused and scrolled toward the bottom edge it lands under the ad. The ad's dismiss control (button.x, aria-label='Close advertisement', onclick removes the ad) is reachable only after tabbing through the whole article; it is the second-to-last focusable element, with the ad's CTA link (a.cta 'Start free trial') following it as the actual last focusable.

The article reflows fine, but the fixed ad obscures the in-article 'listening guide' link when it takes keyboard focus; the only dismiss control (a corner X) is reachable only by advancing focus past the obscured link.
sticky-fixed-content-consumes-small-view.note: Focus-order specific drifted: the corner X (button.x) is NOT 'the last focusable element on the page'. meaningful-indentation-vs-gratuitous-g22.mechanism: EXPECTED OUTCOME SHOULD BE failed, not passed. A nested semantic <ul>/<li> regulatory issue tree lives in .issuetree (overflow-x:auto, an indent-reducing @media(max-width:480px) — the G224 scaffolding), but .issuetree li > .node is white-space:nowrap, so each long regulatory label is locked to one physical line.
